notes.title: Early Access finished and come to version 1.0
notes.notes:
Now Chang'an Captital of Tang Dynasty finished early access and come to version 1.0, which include:
[b]1. New resource and build system[/b]
Residences and Business zones will need supplies, from rice and silk to religion and culture. Each kind of supply is produced in according buildings. Some high level supply buildings like temples or universities will also consume basic supplies. Insufficient supplies will reduce the gold income and population in the city, so players should pay attentions on the supply chains.

[b]2. Improved graphic and UI.[/b]
The graphic of the game is improved a lot. The vegetations in the buildings are refined. and the UI system is totally redesigned.

[b]3. Random events on the map. [/b]
For example we can find a pool on an undeveloped site. We can modify it to a waterside pavilion to get more Happiness, or just keep it as a free water source, or even destroy it to gain a large amount of gold in one time.

After the early access, Chang'an The capital of Tang Dynasty is in version 1.0, and I will keep updating this game by adding new wonder buildings, adding new random events and fixing bugs. Here I would like to thank all players who support this game, and wish you know more about Chang'an, the legendary city in the ancient.

Romulus

notes.title: Version 0.90 Animals in the city
notes.notes:
Version 0.90
1. Animal System.
When players get a new quest, there will be animal camps randomly created on the target zones. Players can catch them by just left click mouse, and animals will be automatically added to according buildings that built after.

There are 9 kinds of animals, when put into new building, them will provide kinds of resources or increase the environment.

3. Public buildings like watch tower, tavern will be constructed immediately.
